tips_en: Start with Paper 1 (FERT/FATS) as it presents the most self-contained, deployable system with striking real-world results—a 97.3% average success rate across five manipulation tasks using 96 robots—and addresses a fundamental scalability challenge (eliminating expert supervision at scale) that has clear practical implications. Papers 2 (EgoX) and 3 (HoliWorld) are thematically linked: both tackle egocentric 3D reconstruction and hand-object interaction from first-person video, sharing overlapping benchmarks (HOT3D, HOI4D, H2O, ADT) and complementary methodologies—EgoX focuses on unified joint reconstruction, while HoliWorld builds a broader ecosystem for world-level spatial reasoning. Read these two together to understand the current frontier of egocentric scene understanding, which also complements Paper 1's robotics focus since hand-object manipulation is a key downstream application.
tips_zh: 建议首先阅读论文1（FERT/FATS），因为它提出了一个最完整、可部署的系统，在五项操作任务上使用96台机器人取得了97.3%的平均成功率，解决了一个关键的扩展性挑战（消除规模化部署中对专家监督的依赖），实际意义最为明确。论文2（EgoX）和论文3（HoliWorld）在主题上高度相关：两者都聚焦于第一人称视频中的以自我为中心的3D重建和手-物体交互，并共享部分基准数据集（HOT3D、HOI4D、H2O、ADT）及互补的方法——EgoX侧重于统一的联合重建，而HoliWorld构建了更广泛的生态系统以实现世界级的空间推理。建议将这两篇一起阅读，以了解以自我为中心场景理解的最新前沿，同时这两篇也能与论文1的机器人主题互补，因为手-物体操作是重要的下游应用方向。
